frozen_candidate_day_rule.free_reference: equal-weight Binance one-second close and latest Bybit public spot trade available by second-end, with Bybit trade age <= 5 seconds at both endpoints
frozen_candidate_day_rule.primary_condition: retain the UTC day if any valid free-reference five-minute return is <= -0.0060
frozen_candidate_day_rule.missing_reference_fallback: if the free reference is unavailable at an endpoint, retain the UTC day if the Binance-only five-minute return is <= -0.0050
frozen_candidate_day_rule.reason_no_lockout: a wider screening event must never suppress a later true -1% final event
frozen_candidate_day_rule.final_trigger: unchanged equal-weight Binance and Bybit spot receipt-time midpoint crossing <= -1% over exactly five minutes with the frozen two-hour lockout

paid_acquisition_order: 1. run the frozen free screen over the common historical window

3. rebuild the exact frozen two-venue receipt-time trigger and two-hour lockout from those paid spot files
4. buy CryptoStruct Bybit perpetual 2449 only for finalized exact event windows requiring the frozen 30-minute liquidity prehistory and t0+15s decision state
